title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-debian-updates-and-rollback-tooling
author: Ethan Morales
description:
Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in highly regulated on-prem/air-gapped environments have requested first-class Debian support for our RKE2 offline bundles and more robust rollback tooling for bundle upgrades. This PR updates the offline bundle vendoring for rke2->debian families, improves apt mirror/metadata handling for air-gapped installs, and adds a safe rollback path that works with TUF-signed bundles. Changes include vendoring of Debian-specific packages, apt archive layout fixes, checksum/TUF metadata regeneration hooks, and an installer-side rollback command that reverts to the previous stable bundle without requiring internet access.

High level changes (summary):
- Add support files for rke2 Debian-based offline bundles (deb packaging, apt metadata fixes).
- Vendor Debian-specific packages into offline bundles and update vendoring scripts.
- Improve mk-offline-bundle CLI: --distro=debian flag, automatic package selection for amd64/arm64, deterministic archive names.
- Add bundle metadata: previous_bundle pointer, signed artifact manifest (TUF-compatible), and extra validation checks during install.
- Implement installer rollback command: redwood-installer rollback --from-bundle <bundle.tar> that restores previous manifest, clears partial state and re-applies previous node manifests.
- Helm chart tweaks: chart values for installer to accept deb-based runtime images and kernel module packaging toggles.
- Integration tests: new e2e-onprem:rke2-debian pipeline that runs install/upgrade/rollback in a VM/rke2 fixture.

Checklist: 
- [x] Vendor Debian packages and update vendoring scripts
- [x] Add apt metadata generation and verify package index layout
- [x] Implement rollback flow in installer and unit tests
- [x] Add e2e integration pipeline for Debian bundle installs
- [x] Update docs (onprem/airgap.md) with new upgrade/rollback instructions
- [x] Run staging rollout on internal infra

Testing and validation:
- Local unit tests updated and passing (mk-offline-bundle unit/test).
- Integration VM-based tests executed in CI: initial failure on metadata ordering required a fix to sortPackages() in vendoring script; rerun passed.
- Manual smoke tests on internal lab (rke2 v1.26 on Debian 12) for install/upgrade/rollback sequences. Logs and test artifacts uploaded to Linear ticket ENG-2148.

Upgrade notes: The new bundle format is backwards compatible for installer versions that understand the previous_bundle pointer; older installers will ignore the pointer but will still be able to install the bundle contents. Rolling back from a bundle produced by this script requires installer >= v0.33.0.

Related work: ENG-2148 (Debian RKE2 offline bundles), ENG-2199 (rollback tooling), SUP-3421 (customer support case replicating broken apt index in airgapped environment).

Merge strategy: squash-merge after approval and green CI. Rollout: staged release to staging clusters, then canary to customer-facing images.

release_notes: Add Debian support for RKE2 offline bundles, deterministic vendoring, apt metadata fixes, and installer rollback tooling. Backwards compatible with existing bundles; installer >= v0.33.0 required for full rollback support.
notes_for_ops: Staging rollout completed. When generating new offline bundles for customers on Debian, set --distro=debian and publish TUF metadata alongside the tarball. If a rollback is required, use 'redwood-installer rollback --from-bundle <bundle>' and ensure installer v0.33.0+ is present on nodes. Monitor installer logs for manifest validation errors.
